existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Copies of public records shall be made available 'at cost' — the office may not charge more than its actual cost of making the copy.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: A requester asks for copies of a public record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost of the copy (no statutory per-page rate)
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Subject to division (B)(8) of this section, upon request by any person, a public office or person responsible for public records shall make copies of the requested public record available to the requester at cost and within a reasonable period of time.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Ohio sets no statutory per-page rate; 'at cost' is a ceiling of actual cost the city fills in. City must set the operative value under this ceiling.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A law enforcement agency or prosecuting attorney's office may charge the actual cost of preparing a video record, not to exceed $75 per hour of video produced and not to exceed $750 total.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: A request is for a video record held by a law enforcement agency or prosecuting attorney's office.
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: ceiling: $75.00 per hour of video produced; ceiling: $750.00 total
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: a state or local law enforcement agency or a prosecuting attorney's office may charge a requester the actual cost associated with preparing a video record for inspection or production, not to exceed seventy-five dollars per hour of video produced, nor seven hundred fifty dollars total.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Two bounds in one conjunctive rule (per-hour ceiling AND total cap). Kept in one row per grain rule. Record-specific to video from law-enforcement/prosecutor offices.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public office may require the requester to pay in advance the cost of providing a copy, in accordance with the format the requester chose.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: A requester asks for a copy of a public record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If any person requests a copy of a public record in accordance with division (B) of this section, the public office or person responsible for the public record may require the requester to pay in advance the cost involved in providing the copy of the public record in accordance with the choice made by the requester under this division.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: A payment gate/branch (require prepayment before producing), so structural. No statutory deposit percentage is set — that is a material negative.
